entries.title: Your crew reaches Bitbucket the way it reaches GitHub and GitLab
entries.body: On a Bitbucket project, your crew can now read and change things on bitbucket.org within the project's own repository, read its pipelines and a step's log, and put a release file in its Downloads. A change anywhere else still waits for your click, and merging still goes through the merge card. New comments on a crewmate's pull request wake it. Your open Bitbucket pull requests show in the open pull requests panel. Bitbucket offers no download of a pipeline's artifacts, so the crew reads the step's log instead.
entries.noPicture: This changes what the crew can reach on Bitbucket; the one view it touches, the Bitbucket row in Integrations, gains the same two action switches GitLab's row already has.
